newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China United buys HK$470 mln property.
newsitem.headline: China United buys HK$470 mln property.

text.p: Gift packaging and property investment concern China United Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it would buy a Hong Kong commercial property from independent third party Get Rich Enterprises Ltd for HK$470 million.
The company said HK$235 million would be paid in cash and the balance would be paid by issuing 556.87 million new shares, or 27.1 percent of the enlarged share capital, at HK$0.422 each.
Shares of China United ended at HK$0.67 on Tuesday.
The property is the basement of a 30-storey commercial building in North Point on Hong Kong island, the company said.
Get Rich is 80 percent owned by Asia Standard International Group Ltd and 20 percent by Paul Y-ITC Construction Holdings Ltd.
